name: Tolaria
description: The island where Urza's academy trained mages to fight Phyrexia.

description_citations.text: "Yawgmoth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin trained the young Ertai.
timeline.quote: Barrin is the teacher who trained the young Ertai.

citation.text: Barrin (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Time floods and Tolaria is drowned in an instant stretching toward infinity.
timeline.quote: Tolaria was drowned in an instant that stretched toward infinity.

citation.text: Sunder (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Barrin explains that in Tolaria wizards practice the art of building dams against time.
timeline.quote: In Tolaria we practice the art of building dams.

citation.text: Rewind (Arena League 1999, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kerrick finds an eviscerator in the time bubble and must unleash it on Tolaria or destroy it.
timeline.quote: Kerrick knew he must soon find a way to unleash it on Tolaria or destroy it.

citation.text: Eviscerator (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kerrick says the sleepers had years to prepare while Tolaria had minutes.
timeline.quote: We had years to prepare, while they had mere minutes.

citation.text: No Mercy (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kerrick's corrupt domain swells on Tolaria like a blister.
timeline.quote: Kerrick's corrupt domain swelled like a blister on Tolaria's skin.

citation.text: Subversion (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Barrin makes a funeral pyre of Tolaria for his family.
timeline.quote: For his family, Barrin made a funeral pyre of Tolaria.

citation.text: Obliterate (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Agnate and Thaddeus are released from the Curtains of Time as the Invasion begins; Agnate collapses and Thaddeus revives him.
timeline.quote: Thaddeus used CPR to revive him

citation.text: "Agnate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza enlists Barrin as headmaster, and they found the Tolarian Academy around 3285 AR.
timeline.quote: they founded the Tolarian Academy around 3285 AR

citation.text: "Barrin", section "Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kerrick attacks Tolaria after getting the time machine plans; Karn is sent back in time to stop him, causing the Tolarian Temporal Disaster that destroys the Academy.
timeline.quote: creating a rift that destroyed the Academy and resulted in the deaths of hundreds of students and faculty

citation.text: "Barrin", section "Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza, Barrin and Karn return to Tolaria and reestablish the Academy with Jhoira's aid.
timeline.quote: Urza, Barrin, and Karn later returned to Tolaria and reestablished the Academy

citation.text: "Barrin", section "The Academy Reborn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kerrick launches the Invasion of Tolaria while Urza is away; Barrin activates a beacon and Urza returns to destroy Kerrick.
timeline.quote: Urza and his Shivan reinforcements attacked and destroyed Kerrick

citation.text: "Barrin", section "Defense of the Academy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin weds Rayne, then realizes Urza chose her as his mate for the Bloodlines.
timeline.quote: Barrin realized that Rayne was selected as his mate by Urza

citation.text: "Barrin", section "The Bloodlines and Rayne". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin forbids Hanna from studying artifacts, causing a falling-out and her move to New Argive.
timeline.quote: Barrin forbade Hanna from studying the artifacts

citation.text: "Barrin", section "Hanna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin returns to Tolaria and casts a spell he vowed never to cast, destroying the island, the Phyrexians, the academy and himself.
timeline.quote: Barrin cast a spell he had vowed never to cast

citation.text: "Barrin", section "Obliteration". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 3347, back at Tolaria after the Invasion of Tolaria began, Urza realizes he needs an army and an heir and starts arranging eugenics matches.
timeline.quote: he started selecting researchers and scholars with particular skill sets within eugenics and started arranging mating matches

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza appoints Rayne chancellor to push her and Barrin into producing an offspring.
timeline.quote: Urza also appointed Rayne as the chancellor of the Tolarian academy

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "First Phase". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza creates the Metathran army in the second phase amid controversy; Barrin contests his methods and some researchers quit.
timeline.quote: Barrin started openly contesting Urza's methods

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "Second Phase". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's time machine attempt devastates Tolaria.
timeline.quote: his attempts at building a time machine ended with the devastation of the island of Tolaria

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "The "Empty Quarter"". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin commits suicide with a spell that liquefies Tolaria.
timeline.quote: the master-mage Barrin committed suicide by casting a devastating spell

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "First Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn goes back in time to close the Tolaria rift, losing his spark.
timeline.quote: He succeeded at the cost of his spark

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin provides Ertai as the Weatherlight's mage; Ertai defeats Hanna in a contest.
timeline.quote: Ertai challenged Hanna to a competition which he won easily.

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Journey to Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn enters the Tolaria rift and returns to the moment before Barrin's spell, sealing the rift before it opens; Karn is lost.
timeline.quote: Karn succeeds and seals the planar rift before Barrin's actions can rip it open.

citation.text: "Future Sight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna leaves Tolaria to study artifice at Argivian University in New Argive, becoming estranged from her father.
timeline.quote: Hanna and Barrin were not on speaking terms for many years as a result.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna loses a competition to Ertai, who then derides her artifacts.
timeline.quote: Hanna challenged Ertai to a competition which she ultimately lost

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin leaves Urza's service, exhumes Hanna's body, reburies her on Tolaria next to his wife, and razes the island to glass.
timeline.quote: Reburying her next to his wife, he then razed the island to glass.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza assembles planeswalkers with his Titan Engines but the gathering draws Phyrexians to Tolaria, so they go to Koilos.
timeline.quote: the gathering of ‘walkers draws the Phyrexians to the island, so they abandon it, traveling to Koilos to plan for the great battle.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Furious that Urza hid Hanna's death, Barrin exhumes her body and casts the obliterate spell, destroying Tolaria.
timeline.quote: Furious, Barrin exhumes his daughter's body and travels to Tolaria, casting the obliterate spell, completely destroying the entire island.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin witnesses a massive Phyrexian assault on Tolaria and summons artifact creatures.
timeline.quote: Barrin witnessed a massive Phyrexian assault, featuring grotesque monsters and warped humanoids.

citation.text: "Invasion of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza teleports in from Yavimaya with Multani's spirit and seals wells and repairs walls.
timeline.quote: Urza teleported in from his imprisonment in Yavimaya carrying the spirit of Multani with him.

citation.text: "Invasion of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza destroys a dam to flood the gorge and infiltrates the time rent.
timeline.quote: He destroyed the dam, unleashing a massive flood that swept him into the gorge.

citation.text: "Invasion of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza cleanses the remaining chambers, allying with Multani.
timeline.quote: solidifying an alliance with the forest spirit.

citation.text: "Invasion of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kerrick uses Jhoira to infiltrate the Academy, causing the disaster that strands her on Tolaria for ten years; she saves Teferi.
timeline.quote: She was used by Kerrick to infiltrate the Academy.

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Academy years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jhoira becomes nearly immortal by drinking time-rift water.
timeline.quote: Jhoira herself became nearly immortal due to her experiences at Tolaria

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Academy years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kerrick crashes on the Tolarian beach and is rescued by the young Jhoira, who falls in love with him and hides him in a cave.
timeline.quote: Kerrick crashed on the Tolarian beach with his ship and was found and rescued by a young Jhoira

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "Castaway". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn, sent back in time by Urza's experiment, finds Kerrick and Jhoira and promises to tell no one.
timeline.quote: Karn discovered Kerrick and Jhoira but promised to tell no one about them.

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "Saboteur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn sees Kerrick stealing blueprints from Urza's lab and follows him to a secret Phyrexian meeting where he overhears the invasion plans.
timeline.quote: Karn overheard the Phyrexian's plans to invade the Academy

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "Saboteur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kerrick brings negators into the Academy, and they slaughter students and teachers, including Jhoira.
timeline.quote: Kerrick had brought Phyrexian negators into the Academy.

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "Saboteur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn finds Jhoira's corpse and slays her killer, a negator; Urza tells him Barrin and Teferi are dead too and sends him back in time.
timeline.quote: Karn then fought and slew Jhoira's killer, a Phyrexian negator.

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "Saboteur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The time machine overloads and explodes, causing the great temporal disaster; Urza petrifies nearby students and staff and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Then the machine exploded and caused the great temporal disaster in Tolaria.

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "Saboteur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin's forces are overrun in the Invasion of Tolaria while Multani holds Urza prisoner in Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: Barrin's forces were finally overrun in the Invasion of Tolaria

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "K'rrik's fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani lends Urza his strength and together they kill K'rrik; Multani animates Tolaria's forests to destroy the remaining negators.
timeline.quote: Multani lent Urza his strength and killed the Phyrexian together

citation.text: "K'rrik", section "K'rrik's fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Barrin create Karn as a time-travel probe, giving him sentience with Xantcha's heartstone.
timeline.quote: Karn was created as a probe by Urza and Barrin to enable their time-travel experiments.

citation.text: "Karn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jhoira takes Karn from Teferi's harassment and names him Karn, a Thran word for mighty.
timeline.quote: She granted him the name Karn, a Thran word for "mighty" or "strength".

citation.text: "Karn", section "Tolarian Academy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn uses Urza's time machine to save Jhoira from a Phyrexian sleeper agent, causing the Tolarian Temporal Disaster.
timeline.quote: the time machine suffered a catastrophic failure and caused the Tolarian Temporal Disaster

citation.text: "Karn", section "Tolarian Academy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn returns with Urza and Barrin to rebuild Tolaria and finds Jhoira alive and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble.
timeline.quote: discovered Jhoira still alive, and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble

citation.text: "Karn", section "Tolarian Academy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn travels back in time to seal the rift over Tolaria and gives up his spark, leaving him vulnerable to Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: gave up his spark to do so before being flung back to the present

citation.text: "Karn", section "Time Rifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani, still in Urza's mind, infuses him with energy so Urza can kill K'rrick at Tolaria.
timeline.quote: allowing Urza to kill K'rrick by teleporting inside of him

citation.text: "Multani", section "Timestreams". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn time travels to just before Barrin cast Obliterate and seals the Tolarian rift, but senses a dark corruption and flees across the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: proceeds to planeswalk randomly throughout the Blind Eternities to prevent anyone from following him.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai agrees to join the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: Ertai agrees to join the crew

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Ertai's Tale" (Hannovi Braddock)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai defeats a fog elemental with the Chimeric Sphere.
timeline.quote: attacks from the mists surrounding the hill, which Ertai defeats by piloting the Chimeric Sphere with a Mind Stone

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Ertai's Tale" (Hannovi Braddock)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's failed time experiment creates the Tolarian rift, felt immediately.
timeline.quote: the Tolarian rift was felt immediately after it came into being

citation.text: "Rift", section "Tolarian rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin obliterates Tolaria, worsening the Tolarian rift beyond repair.
timeline.quote: the rift was worsened beyond repair when Barrin obliterated all of Tolaria

citation.text: "Rift", section "Tolarian rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn travels back in time and mends the Tolarian rift just before Barrin's spell.
timeline.quote: it was necessary for Karn to travel back in time and mend the rift just before Barrin cast his obliteration spell.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Tolarian rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians attack Tolaria and Karn travels back in time to stop them, causing the Tolarian Temporal Disaster; Teferi is trapped in a slow-time bubble for thirty years.
timeline.quote: Teferi survived but was caught in a slow-time bubble for thirty years

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Early years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jhoira builds a portal machine and Karn and Urza pull Teferi out of the bubble.
timeline.quote: the resilient bodies of Karn and Urza could pass through and pull Teferi out

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Early years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's time travel experiments cause a temporal explosion at Tolaria, forming the Tolarian rift.
timeline.quote: which fragmented time around the academy and formed the Tolarian rift

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Causes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn travels into the past to seal the Tolarian rift, then flees to Mirrodin unknowingly carrying Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: traveled into the past to seal the Tolarian rift

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A phantom monster summoned by Barrin's time-travel spellcasting kills Skaven; Urza rescues Barrin and dispels the creature.
timeline.quote: The creature kills Skaven and pulls Barrin toward a time bubble.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "The Reluctant Student , by Tim Ryan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza gives a silver golem Xantcha's heart; named Karn, it learns emotions and befriends Jhoira while Teferi harasses it.
timeline.quote: taking the name Karn from the Thran word for mighty

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jhoira hides the shipwrecked Kerrick; Karn sees him steal powerstones and call for Negators, who massacre the students and teachers including Jhoira, Teferi and Barrin.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian Negators massacred most of the students and teachers including Jhoira, Teferi, and Barrin.

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn travels back to stop Kerrick, but the temporal surge causes an explosion that levels the academy; Urza planeswalks fourteen people to safety and Karn leads thirty survivors out.
timeline.quote: cause a huge explosion that levels the academy

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ten years later Urza and Barrin return to Tolaria, where time rifts nearly kill them until Jhoira, who survived, saves them and shows them the fast-time chasm holding Kerrick and the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Urza realizes that Kerrick and the surviving Phyrexians are stuck inside.

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's dirigible attack on the chasm fails and Jhoira falls into a coma; she later builds a machine to funnel fast time into slow-time areas, saving Teferi.
timeline.quote: Jhoira falls into a coma for several years

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's falcon attack fails and he is captured and disemboweled by K’rrik until Karn rescues him.
timeline.quote: Karn sees Urza fall into the chasm and rushes into it

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin's beacon wakes Urza; Multani sees Urza protecting life, and the two kill K’rrik and destroy the Negators.
timeline.quote: Multani animates Tolaria's forests and the remaining negators are destroyed.

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's failed experiments on Tolaria produce fast and slow bubbles of time.
timeline.quote: Failed experiments by Urza on Tolaria resulted in fast and slow bubbles of time.

citation.text: "Time stream", section "Slowing and quickening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn, now the embodiment of the Legacy, travels hundreds of years back in time without a machine.
timeline.quote: he succeeded in moving hundreds of years back in time.

citation.text: "Time stream", section "Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn's time travel on Tolaria changes the result of the Phyrexian invasion on that island.
timeline.quote: changed the result of the Phyrexian invasion on that island

citation.text: "Time stream", section "Mechanisms and paradoxes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Barrin build and give life to Karn.
timeline.quote: Karn is built and given life at the Tolarian Academy by Urza and Barrin .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians overrun the Tolarian Academy in the Tolarian Temporal Disaster.
timeline.quote: Phyrexians overrun the Tolarian Academy and kill everyone.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin, maddened by grief, annihilates Tolaria and himself.
timeline.quote: A grief-maddened Barrin commits suicide by annihilating all of Tolaria.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Phyrexian Invasion (4205 AR to 4206 AR) [ 16 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Barrin found the Tolarian Academy on Tolaria, admitting only children.
timeline.quote: Urza and Barrin founded the Tolarian Academy

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Tolarian Academy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza creates the golem-probe Karn to survive time travel in his plan to change the past.
timeline.quote: Urza created a golem-probe, soon after named Karn

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Tolarian Academy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn uses the time machine to save Jhoira, whose life was taken by a Phyrexian sleeper agent.
timeline.quote: taken by a Phyrexian sleeper agent during a Phyrexian assault in 3307 AR

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Tolarian Temporal Disaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The time machine fails catastrophically, destroying the academy and leaving Tolaria a shattered temporal landscape.
timeline.quote: destroying the academy and leaving Tolaria a shattered temporal landscape.

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Tolarian Temporal Disaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza escapes with Barrin and thirteen others, Karn rescues thirty-three more, and Jhoira is stranded alone.
timeline.quote: but Jhoira was stranded alone.

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Tolarian Temporal Disaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza, Barrin and Karn return with new students and find Jhoira alive and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble.
timeline.quote: discovered Jhoira still alive, and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble.

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Invasion of Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Invasion of Tolaria begins while Urza is away, and is ended by Barrin, Jhoira, Teferi and their allies.
timeline.quote: This invasion was ended only through the combined efforts of Barrin and his students, faculty, and artifact creatures

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Invasion of Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza secretly starts the Bloodline Project to create mortal heroes to wield the Legacy against Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza also secretly started the Bloodline Project

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Bloodline Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin seals Hanna in a sarcophagus and obliterates Tolaria with a massive spell after the Phyrexians swarm it.
timeline.quote: he sealed Hanna in an impenetrable sarcophagus and obliterated the entire island with a massive spell

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Obliteration of Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Barrin found the Tolarian Academy on Tolaria.
timeline.quote: founded on the island of Tolaria by Urza and Barrin in 3285 AR

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn uses Urza's time machine to save Jhoira; the machine fails, destroying the first academy and creating the Tolarian Time Rift.
timeline.quote: destroying the first academy and leaving Tolaria a shattered temporal landscape

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy", section "Tolarian Temporal Disaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Barrin escape with students; Karn rescues twenty more; Jhoira is stranded.
timeline.quote: Jhoira was stranded alone

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy", section "Tolarian Temporal Disaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ten years later Urza, Barrin and Karn return, find Jhoira alive and Teferi trapped, and rescue him.
timeline.quote: discovered Jhoira still alive, and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy", section "The Invasion of Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Invasion of Tolaria is ended by Barrin, students, Jhoira, Teferi and Shiv allies.
timeline.quote: the Invasion of Tolaria began, with K'rrik 's negators swarming over the island

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy", section "The Invasion of Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin destroys the island with its occupants while grieving his daughter Hanna.
timeline.quote: Barrin destroyed the whole island along with all of its occupants

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy", section "Destruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The set's story follows Urza as he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him.
timeline.quote: he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him

timeline.summary: K'rrik destroys Urza's academy on Tolaria despite Karn's time travel; Urza later defeats K'rrik with Multani's help.
timeline.quote: K'rrik succeeded in destroying the place, but Urza sent the silver golem Karn back in time to prevent this.
